description: This file defines the structure and function prototypes for managing rbus elements, including element node structure, mutex locking macros, and functions for element manipulation and subscriptions in an rbus system.

classes.name: elementNode
classes.description: Represents an element in the rbus system, including its name, hierarchy, type, callback table, subscriptions, and mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: getEmptyElementNode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty elementNode instance.

methods.name: freeElementNode
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an elementNode.

methods.name: insertElement
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the element hierarchy.

methods.name: removeElement
methods.description: Removes an element from the hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveElement
methods.description: Retrieves an element by name from the hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveInstanceElement
methods.description: Retrieves an instance element by name.

methods.name: printRegisteredElements
methods.description: Prints all registered elements starting from the root.

methods.name: fprintRegisteredElements
methods.description: Prints all registered elements to a file.

methods.name: addElementSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription to an element.

methods.name: removeElementSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from an element.

methods.name: elementHasAutoPubSubscriptions
methods.description: Checks if an element has auto-publish subscriptions, excluding a specific subscription.

methods.name: addInstanceToElement
methods.description: Adds an instance to an element.

methods.name: instantiateTableRow
methods.description: Creates a new table row element.

methods.name: getPropertyInstanceNames
methods.description: Retrieves property instance names based on a query.

methods.name: setPropertyChangeComponent
methods.description: Sets the component name for a property change.

methods.name: rbusElement_mutex_destroy
methods.description: Destroys mutexes associated with element nodes.
